blocks.text: A bond’s price is the present value of its cash flows. When yields rise, those cash flows are discounted more heavily, so the price falls. The relationship is curved, not straight.
where D is modified duration and Δy is the change in yield, in decimal.

blocks.name: price-yield.html
blocks.cap: The marker drifts through yields. The dashed tangent is what duration predicts; the shaded gap is what it misses.

blocks.text: Duration is a first-order estimate. It is good for small moves and too pessimistic for large ones, which is why convexity matters.
Convexity measures how much the slope itself changes as yields move. For a plain bond it is positive, so prices rise more than duration predicts when yields fall, and fall less when they rise.
Ten countries, one at a time, starting with Germany on Mon 4 Jan. The first pass builds each view from scratch; the return visit refreshes it.
Monthly returns use Modified Dietz, which weights each cash flow by how long it was in the fund.
Security-level attribution uses the same flows, so the two must reconcile to the administrator NAV.
Type / on an empty line for the block menu. Headings number themselves: 1, 1.1, 1.1.1.
Ask Claude for a self-contained HTML chart, save the file, and drop it anywhere on a page. It runs live inside the page and is saved with it.
Resize by dragging the bottom edge, or pick S, M or L.
Replace swaps in a new version of the file and keeps the caption.

sampleChart.name: price-yield.html
sampleChart.html:
<!doctype html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Albert+Sans:wght@400;600&family=JetBrains+Mono&display=swap">
<style>
html,body{margin:0;height:100%;background:transparent;font-family:'Albert Sans',sans-serif;color:#134848}
svg{display:block;width:100%;height:100%}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<svg id="s"></svg>
<script>
const s = document.getElementById('s');
const price = y => { let p = 0; for (let t = 1; t <= 10; t++) p += 3 / Math.pow(1 + y, t); return p + 100 / Math.pow(1 + y, 10); };
const dur = y => { const p = price(y); let d = 0; for (let t = 1; t <= 10; t++) d += t * 3 / Math.pow(1 + y, t + 1); d += 10 * 100 / Math.pow(1 + y, 11); return d / p; };
const mono = 'font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace"';
const t0 = performance.now();
function draw(now) {
  const w = s.clientWidth, h = s.clientHeight, L = 58, R = w - 28, T = 30, B = h - 42;
  const y0 = 0.005, y1 = 0.07, p0 = 60, p1 = 132;
  const X = y => L + (y - y0) / (y1 - y0) * (R - L), Y = p => B - (p - p0) / (p1 - p0) * (B - T);
  const k = Math.min(1, (now - t0) / 1400), e = 1 - Math.pow(1 - k, 3);
  const yc = 0.032 + 0.018 * Math.sin((now - t0) / 2800), pc = price(yc), D = dur(yc);
  let path = ''; const N = 140;
  for (let i = 0; i <= N * e; i++) { const y = y0 + (y1 - y0) * i / N; path += (i ? 'L' : 'M') + X(y).toFixed(1) + ',' + Y(price(y)).toFixed(1); }
  const tl = y => pc * (1 - D * (y - yc)), ta = yc - 0.022, tb = yc + 0.022;
  let g = '';
  for (let p = 70; p <= 130; p += 20) g += '<line x1="' + L + '" x2="' + R + '" y1="' + Y(p) + '" y2="' + Y(p) + '" stroke="#e1ddd8"/><text x="' + (L - 10) + '" y="' + (Y(p) + 4) + '" text-anchor="end" font-size="11" fill="#5f5a54" ' + mono + '>' + p + '</text>';
  for (let y = 0.01; y <= 0.0701; y += 0.02) g += '<text x="' + X(y) + '" y="' + (B + 20) + '" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#5f5a54" ' + mono + '>' + Math.round(y * 100) + '%</text>';
  g += '<path d="' + path + '" fill="none" stroke="#009D80" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>';
  if (k >= 1) {
    const gap = [];
    for (let i = 0; i <= 30; i++) { const y = ta + (tb - ta) * i / 30; gap.push(X(y).toFixed(1) + ',' + Y(price(y)).toFixed(1)); }
    for (let i = 30; i >= 0; i--) { const y = ta + (tb - ta) * i / 30; gap.push(X(y).toFixed(1) + ',' + Y(tl(y)).toFixed(1)); }
    g += '<polygon points="' + gap.join(' ') + '" fill="#C98A12" opacity="0.14"/>';
    g += '<line x1="' + X(ta) + '" y1="' + Y(tl(ta)) + '" x2="' + X(tb) + '" y2="' + Y(tl(tb)) + '" stroke="#C98A12" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/>';
    g += '<line x1="' + X(yc) + '" x2="' + X(yc) + '" y1="' + Y(pc) + '" y2="' + B + '" stroke="#134848" opacity="0.2"/>';
    g += '<circle cx="' + X(yc) + '" cy="' + Y(pc) + '" r="6" fill="#fdfcf9" stroke="#134848" stroke-width="2"/>';
    const lx = X(yc) + 14, right = lx > w - 300;
    const ax = right ? X(yc) - 14 : lx, anc = right ? 'end' : 'start';
    g += '<text x="' + ax + '" y="' + (Y(pc) - 14) + '" text-anchor="' + anc + '" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#134848">y ' + (yc * 100).toFixed(2) + '%  ·  P ' + pc.toFixed(2) + '  ·  D ' + D.toFixed(2) + '</text>';
  }
  g += '<text x="' + L + '" y="16" font-size="11" fill="#5f5a54" ' + mono + '>PRICE · 10Y, 3% COUPON</text>';
  g += '<text x="' + R + '" y="16" text-anchor="end" font-size="11" fill="#5f5a54"><tspan fill="#009D80">━</tspan> price  <tspan fill="#C98A12">╌</tspan> duration estimate  <tspan fill="#C98A12" opacity="0.6">■</tspan> convexity</text>';
  s.innerHTML = g;
  requestAnimationFrame(draw);
}
requestAnimationFrame(draw);
</script>
</body>
</html>
